Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Shalini Khan. I am a 38-year-old railway employee living in Kolhapur. My spouse Ishita Gowda and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of INR 48,90,000/-, and both spouses have lived apart for a long time. My case number is Petition No. 860/2021 in the Family Court at Kolhapur. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 97993 78962 or email shalini.khan@example.com.
